title: Math Circle Board
job: Help a volunteer facilitator sequence open-ended problems, see partial attempts, preserve private strategy notes, and print a one-page session recap for a tiny math circle.
audience: Adult facilitators of private groups of 6–12 learners
privacy: Adult-owned, minimal learner PII, private uploads, export and deletion controls
monetization: Freemium; one-time Circle Plus license through Sociobot billing
